image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is positioned diagonally across a textured, light-brown rock surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad, and its limbs are splayed out in a walking posture. A long, slender tail extends behind it, tapering to a point. To the left, there are dry brown leaves and debris, suggesting a terrestrial forest floor environment.
